reason: The declaration defaults allowDisconnected to false and from to __builtin_FUNCTION(), so the one-argument queueRequest call uses those defaults. The helper checks disconnection before state and returns -ENODEV when disconnected; otherwise it returns -EACCES if the state is not CameraRunning. queueRequest propagates either negative result unchanged before checking the request contents. The Korean and English claims are therefore supported without changes.
